रिच् रिण॑क्ति pp. रिक्त॑ (q.v.) leave, clear (a room),
let go, let free;
 deliver up, part with, sell;
 leave behind, supplant.
P.M. रिच्य॑ते, रि॑च्यते be emptied, be deprived of or freed from
(instr.), be destroyed, perish. C. रेचयति make empty, give up,
abandon;
 emit breath (±मारुतम्). अति M.P. leave behind, reach
beyond, surpass, predominate over (acc. or abl.). C. cause to
preponderate, overdo. अभ्यति M.P. be left in favour or for the sake
of (acc.). व्यति P. reach beyond, surpass, excel, differ from (acc. or
abl.). आ cede, yield (dat. of pers. & acc. of th.). उद् & प्र M.P.
reach beyond, exceed, preponderate over (abl.). वि M.P. the same, be
emptied or purged. C. empty, purge. — Cf. अ॑तिरिक्त, उ॑द्रिक्त,
विरिक्त, व्यतिरिक्त.
